about: A catalogue of apps, relays and receivers, hosted hubs, hardware, production tools and communities for IRL streaming. One entry per product; ids are permanent. Descriptions are our own words; url is the maker's own page; support lists official public channels from the maker's own pages (help centres, docs, issue trackers, contact pages; no chat invites). role says what it is for (streaming-app, extra-connections, camera-capture, remote-control, chat-overlays, other-app, relay, hub, production, hardware, community; allowed roles depend on kind, see ../schema). part says where along the chain (camera, sender, connections, receiver, obs, platform) the product sits, first the main one; community entries (docs, wikis) have no part and instead name the products they document in covers. Validated by the zod schema in ../schema.

services.name: Bond Bunny
services.description: Android app that takes an SRT stream from another app on the phone and sends it to an SRTLA receiver over several connections; from LifeStreamer's developer.
